data.name: Badawi
data.long_meaning: A person originally from the desert or arid region. In Islamic history, the Badawis were a group of nomadic tribes known for their strength, bravery, and self-sufficiency.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of strength and resilience, the name Badawi represents the spirit of the desert and the indomitable spirit of those who inhabit it. It is a reminder of the power of the human spirit to endure and thrive in even the harshest of environments.
data.numerology_meaning: People with the name Badawi have strong and powerful personalities. They are natural leaders and have a strong sense of self-sufficiency and independence.

in_arabic.name: بدوي
in_arabic.meaning: منسوب إلى البدو، الشخص الذي يعيش في الصحراء
in_arabic.long_meaning: بدوي هو الشخص الذي يعيش في البادية، وهم الناس الذين يتركون المدن ويعيشون في المناطق الصحراوية، بعيدًا عن الحضر والمدن، وغالبًا ما يكونون من الرعاة والزراع، اسم بدوي مشتق من الجذر العربي (ب-د-ي) الذي يعني البداوة أو الحياة في البادية.

in_urdu.name: بدوی
in_urdu.meaning: صحرائی، وہ شخص جو صحرا میں رہتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: بدوی کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو صحرا میں رہتا ہے، بدوی عرب کے ان لوگوں کو کہا جاتا ہے جو شہروں اور بستیوں سے دور صحراؤں میں رہتے ہیں، ان کی زندگی کا دارومدار پશوپال و زراعت پر ہوتا ہے، نام بدوی عربی جڑ (ب-د-ي) سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے بداوة یا صحرائی زندگی.

in_hindi.name: बदवी
in_hindi.meaning: रेगिस्तानी, मरुस्थल में रहने वाला व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: बदवी का अर्थ है मरुस्थल में रहने वाला व्यक्ति, विशेषकर वे लोग जो शहरों से दूर रेगिस्तानी इलाकों में बसते हैं और जिनका जीवन चरागाह और कृषि पर निर्भर करता है, यह नाम अरबी मूल (ब-د-य) से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है बदावत या रेगिस्तानी जीवन.

in_pashto.name: بدوي
in_pashto.meaning: سندګر، هغه څوک چې په صحرا کې اوسي
in_pashto.long_meaning: بدوي هغه څوک دي چې په صحرا کې اوسي، بدوي د هغو کسانو څخه دي چې د ښارونو او بستیو څخه لیري په صحراؤ کې ژوند کوي، د هغوی د ژوندانه پوری د څارويو پالنه او کرنه ده، بدوي نوم د عربي ريښې (ب-د-ي) څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی يې بداوة یا صحرائی ژوند دی.

in_english.name: Badawi
in_english.meaning: Desert dweller, one who lives in the wilderness
in_english.long_meaning: The name Badawi is derived from the Arabic root (ب-د-ي) 'badawī', meaning 'one who lives in the desert'. Badawi refers to individuals who reside in the wilderness or desert areas, far from urban centers. Historically, these people were often involved in pastoralism and agriculture. The term connotes a lifestyle associated with freedom, resilience, and a deep connection to nature. In Islamic tradition, the name may reflect a sense of ruggedness and self-sufficiency.

data.cultural_impact: The Badawis represent a proud nomadic Arab tradition that has survived for centuries against all odds. They have maintained their distinct identity amidst the ever-changing political landscape of the Middle East. Their reputation for resilience and resourcefulness has become a symbol of hope and survival in harsh desert environments.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the Badawis are seen as representatives of the early migrant prophets, including Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham) and his family. Their journey as desert nomads mirrors the spiritual pilgrimage of believers towards Allah, not only through the physical journey of Hajj but also through the everyday trials and tribulations of life. The Badawi name evokes the spirit of self-reliance, courage, and steadfastness required to navigate both the physical desert and the spiritual travels on the path to Allah.
